final: SELECT step1.rating, step1.avg_replacement_cost, step1.rental_price_per_day, step1.rental_price_per_day / step2.avg_ratio FROM (SELECT f.rating, AVG(f.replacement_cost) as avg_replacement_cost, AVG(f.rental_rate) / AVG(f.rental_duration) as rental_price_per_day FROM film f GROUP BY f.rating) step1, (SELECT AVG(inner.rental_price_per_day) as avg_ratio FROM (SELECT f.rating, AVG(f.rental_rate) / AVG(f.rental_duration) as rental_price_per_day FROM film f GROUP BY f.rating) inner) step2
